text: Dark Dragon Shrine: Near the Top
So this is what he meant...\nWe won't be able to go directly to Eldenbaum if\nit's like this...
...Hey, doesn't it look like a huge bird nest from\nafar? But considering the size of the tree, it\nwould be too big to be true. I wonder what it is...
Last time it was indoor, so we didn't realize it\nat a glance. Now I'm sure...That's Plastida,\nCoenubia's colony we saw in the Dark Realm!
